state_layout.registry_types: SessionState, DataFrame, MemTable and DefaultPhysicalPlanner use the same locked DataFusion release in both builds.
state_layout.checked_operands: Entry frames, stack slots, object field offsets and rebased vtable size, alignment, method targets and nested trait tables agree in the matched routines.

method: Apple LLVM Mach-O arm64 disassembly removes instruction addresses and symbolizes calls and local branches. Normalize calls to the same Mach-O stub target. Normalize adjacent page/offset pairs only when the linked symbol, full C string, 4096 destination bytes in __TEXT,__const, or exact loaded bytes match. Resolve loader-declared rebases when comparing data-constant records, including their pointees, nested supertrait vtables and unchanged scalar fields. Retain all other operands, including stack and field offsets and unresolved linked page destinations.
